editaccount-desc: Waxay u oggolaanaysaa xubnaha isticmaalayaasha leh mudnaanta inay [[Special:EditAccount|maareeyaan macluumaadka akoonnada isticmaalaha]]
editaccount-usage:
Xogta isticmaalaha waxaa si gooni ah loogu kaydiyaa wiki kasta.
Markaad dib u dejiso furaha sirta ah ama iimaylka, kaydka xogta waxaa laga nadiifinayaa wiki-gan oo keliya.
Fadlan isticmaalaha ku hag wiki-gan si uu ugu soo galo furaha sirta ah ee cusub loo dejiyay, si looga fogaado dhibaatooyinka kaydka xogta.
editaccount-label-pass: Deji furaha sirta ah ee cusub
editaccount-label-realname: Deji magaca dhabta ah ee cusub
editaccount-label-toggleadopt: Wax ka beddel heerka korsadaha (ee AutomaticWikiAdopt):
editaccount-usage-close: Waxaad sidoo kale damin kartaa akoonka isticmaalaha adigoo qasaya furaha sirta ah oo ka saaraya ciwaanka iimaylka. Ogow in xogtan ay lumin doonto oo aan dib loo soo celin karin.
editaccount-warning-close: DIGNIIN! Waxaad qarka u saaran tahay inaad si joogto ah u damiso akoonka isticmaalaha $1. Tani dib looguma celin karo. Ma hubtaa inaad sidaas samaynayso?
editaccount-success-email: Ciwaanka iimaylka ee akoonka $1 waxaa loo beddelay $2.
editaccount-success-email-blank: Ciwaanka iimaylka ayaa laga saaray akoonka $1.
editaccount-success-pass: Furaha sirta ah ee akoonka $1 waa la beddelay.
editaccount-success-realname: Magaca dhabta ah ee akoonka $1 waa la beddelay.
editaccount-success-unsub: Calaamaddii ka noqoshada rukhsadda ayaa laga saaray akoonka $1.
editaccount-success-disable: Calaamaddii daminta ayaa laga saaray akoonka $1.
editaccount-success-toggleadopt: Xaaladda ubqalmitaanka korsashada ee akoonka $1 waa la beddelay.
editaccount-error-email: Ciwaanka iimaylka lama beddelin. Fadlan mar kale isku day goor dambe.
editaccount-error-pass: Furaha sirta ah lama beddelin. Fadlan mar kale isku day goor dambe.
editaccount-error-realname: Magaca dhabta ah lama beddelin. Fadlan mar kale isku day goor dambe.
editaccount-error-close: Dhibaato ayaa dhacday markii akoonka la xirayay. Fadlan mar kale isku day goor dambe.
editaccount-invalid-email: "$1" ma aha ciwaan iimayl oo sax ah!
editaccount-not-loaded: Khalad: Xogta isticmaalaha si sax ah looma soo gelin, fadlan isku day inaad bogga dib u soo geliso.
editaccount-remove-avatar-fail: Dhibaato ayaa ka dhacday si otomaatig ah looga saarayo sawirka astaanta.
editaccount-requested: Ogow: Isticmaaluhu wuxuu codsaday in akoonka la xiro.
editaccount-not-requested: DIGNIIN: Isticmaaluhu ma codsan in akoonka la xiro
editaccount-error-tempuser-email: Isticmaalayaasha ku-meelgaarka ah ma yeelan karaan goob ciwaan iimayl oo madhan, fadlan geli ciwaan iimayl.
editaccount-email-change-requested: Isticmaaluhu wuxuu ka codsaday Dookhyada in ciwaanka iimaylka loo beddelo $1. Si loo xaqiijiyo beddelka ciwaanka iimaylka uu isticmaaluhu codsaday, geli ciwaanka iimaylka la codsaday goobta hoose kadibna guji "{{int:editaccount-submit-email}}."
log-description-editaccnt: Boggan wuxuu taxayaa isbeddellada ay shaqaalaha {{SITENAME}} ku sameeyeen macluumaadka isticmaalaha.
logentry-editaccnt-passchange: $1 beddelay furaha sirta ah ee isticmaalaha $3
logentry-editaccnt-realnamechange: $1 beddelay magaca dhabta ah ee isticmaalaha $3
edit-account-closed-flag: Koontadan waxaa si caalami ah u curyaamiyay {{SITENAME}}.
action-editaccount: wax ka beddel macluumaadka isticmaalayaasha kale
right-editaccount: Wax ka beddel macluumaadka isticmaalayaasha kale
